name: Elder Skyseer
summary: Elder Skyseer is the spirit of an ancestral tauren residing atop the towering bluffs of Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. As an honoured elder returned from the spirit world, he observes the ongoing journeys of the Horde and remains deeply tied to the resting grounds of his people.

sections.title: A Spirit of Freewind Post
sections.body: Perched high above the salt canyons of Thousand Needles, Elder Skyseer lingers at the windswept mesa settlement of Freewind Post. While the tauren of Freewind Post bustle around the outpost's perilous bridges and wooden platforms, Skyseer watches over the realm as an ancestor who has crossed beyond the mortal veil. He serves as an ancestral beacon for travelers seeking the wisdom of past generations, offering his blessings to those who honor old traditions.

sections.title: Ties to the Ancestral Lands
sections.body: Though his spirit commonly manifests among the wind-carved needles, Skyseer belongs to the long line of tauren ancestors whose people honor the sacred soil of Mulgore, where the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks watch over the tribes. Spirits like Skyseer reveal how thin the veil between the physical realm and the ancestral spirits remains for the tauren, guiding future generations through remembrance and ritual.

faq.answer: Elder Skyseer is an ancestral tauren spirit who appears at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He is one of the revered elders whose spirits watch over modern travelers, offering ancestral guidance to those who seek him out.

faq.q: Why is Elder Skyseer a ghost?
faq.answer: He is an ancient ancestor who has passed on from the mortal world. Tauren culture maintains a deep spiritual connection to their forebears, and certain prominent elders linger or return in spirit form to guide the living.

faq.q: What is his connection to Mulgore?
faq.answer: Like all tauren ancestors, Skyseer is honored by a people whose homeland is Mulgore, where the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks watch over the tribes. His own spirit, however, appears at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Skyseer?
faq.answer: Elder Skyseer is located at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles, lingering atop the fortified mesa settlement high above the canyon floor.

angles.text: For the tauren, encountering Elder Skyseer is a direct communion with an ancestor, embodying the spiritual reverence taught at Red Rocks and across the plains of Mulgore.
As spiritual mediators who speak to the elements and spirits, shamans recognize in Elder Skyseer the enduring wisdom of ancestors who continue to watch over the living.
